clusters.pick_reason: PR #2243 fixes the root cause automatically: it detects and re-applies the gateway path prefix without requiring any caller changes, and its _resolve_endpoint_url handles full URLs, absolute paths, and relative paths explicitly with a documented example. PR #2531 adds a messages_url override parameter that works around the same failure scenario, but only when the user manually discovers and supplies the correct URL — the fallback path still uses bare urljoin and therefore still drops the prefix in the unoverridden case. #2243's automatic fix covers the common case #2531 cannot, so #2531's workaround is made redundant if #2243 lands. The two functions share the same name and cannot coexist without a rewrite.
